description: This file defines an interface for a grain in an Orleans distributed system, specifying methods for stream subscription management, test object handling, and retrieving identifiers.

methods.name: SubscribeToStream
methods.description: Subscribes the grain to a specified stream identified by GUID and provider name.

methods.name: UnsubscribeFromStream
methods.description: Unsubscribes the grain from its current stream.

methods.name: SendTestObject
methods.description: Sends a test object to the stream, using the specified provider name.

methods.name: SetTestObjectStringProperty
methods.description: Sets the string property of the test object.

methods.name: GetTestObjectStringProperty
methods.description: Retrieves the string property of the test object.

methods.name: GetSiloIdentifier
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the silo where this grain is hosted.
